versions.summary: International waybill system, wallet recharge, and admin order/waybill management

changes.description: International waybill system: apply for shipment from warehoused orders, list/detail, pay shipping fee from wallet, confirm receipt. Waybill lifecycle: 待合单→待打包→待支付→待出库→已发货→已收货
Wallet recharge system: query available payment methods, create recharge order, idempotent payment callback, status query. Amount range: 1,000~500,000 JPY
Admin/WMS endpoints: automation script order state transitions (Paid→Purchasing→Warehoused), WMS waybill lifecycle management, shipping fee and tracking info
OrderResponse now includes firstGoodsImg field for displaying the first item's image in order list

versions.summary: User behavior analysis and personalized recommendation system

changes.description: User preference categories: set and retrieve preferred product categories
Behavior tracking: async recording of product views (5-min dedup) and search keywords
Personalized recommendations: 4 list types (for_you/browsing/sellers/new_arrivals), 6 items per list, first item highlighted, Redis-cached 30min
Auto-records browsing history for authenticated users (fire-and-forget)

versions.summary: Order system, wallet system, and seller follow features

changes.description: Order system: settlement preview, order creation with wallet deduction, payment, cancellation, and order list with details
JPY wallet system: balance query, transaction history, and admin balance adjustment
Seller follow/unfollow with pagination and batch check
Email verification code for registration (SMTP, 6-digit code, 10min TTL)
Order list now includes orderDetailList with goodsImg field

versions.summary: Initial release with search, auth, cart, favorites, and OAuth

changes.description: Product search, detail, and platform search endpoints
User registration, login, and OAuth (Google/Apple) authentication
Shopping cart with seller grouping and price change detection
Favorites with pagination and batch check
Surugaya proxy endpoints: reviews, stores, discounts, comments, campaigns, categories
